Minestrator.desc: [Minestrator](https://minestrator.com/) is a french minecraft host that's currently being used to host CashCraft.

HS1.desc: HS1, or High Speed One, is the first High Speed operator in CashCraft. It currently serves the inner portion of the server, connecting stations such as Hemstead Central, New Arbridge Central and Ailsbury E.Q. It is currently managed by Movies22.

Geyser.desc: [Geyser](https://geysermc.org/) is a plugin that's used in CashCraft to allow Bedrock Players to join the server.

LuckPerms.desc:
1) [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/) is a plugin that's used in CashCraft to manage the member's permissions within the game.
2) LuckPerms is often used to refer to giving the default permissions (Creative/Fly perms) to New Members.

Plot Reminder.desc: In CashCraft, you have a 2 week deadline to finish building your plots. The bot will send you a reminder in #reminders 48 hours and 24 hours before your plots expire.

Points.desc:
Points are given when you break one or multiple rules. Once you reach a specific amount of points, a moderative action will be taken (Refer to #rules).
Points usually come with evidence attached, the amount of points given, the reason for those points and a warn ID which can be used to appeal them.

CNRN.desc:
CNRN (CashCraft National Railway Network) is the main transport operator in CashCraft, managing all metro lines, all Heavy Rail operators, New Arbridge/New Oak Trams and Fernhill Trams.
It has a HQ at Herald Street, where you can find offices for all Transport Staff at that time.

Plot Codes.desc:
Each plot that was created on the server after February 2022 has its own plot code. Each plot code has a letter to indicate a village (T for Airport and O for Hamlets/LV Zones) and two letters to indicate the area of the village (or the Hamlet/LV Zone). The 4th letter is used to indicate the kind if plot.
You can read more about plot codes here: https://discord.com/channels/903230722603614279/903230723069198378/1190639639590080592

CashCraft SMP.desc: The CashCraft SMP was a former feature that was discontinued in September last year due to extremely low activity. It was first created by Arcoda in July 2022, with it being reset in March 2023 to bring back activity to the SMP. During its lifetime, multiple alliances formed, such as "The Commonwealth", "The Bandits" and "Squed Bus Depot".

The Commonwealth.desc: The Commonwealth was a former SMP alliance formed by Movies22, Magma, Supa, Federer, Lazer, AJ, Space and redredstone. It was responsible for building HS1 and HS2 on the 1st SMP. Currently, most members of this alliance work together on other projects. The "AlCorp" commercial alliance was also formed as a successor to this alliance.

Project Areas.desc:
Project Areas was a feature that was created by Dweller to allow members to have their own mini villages. They were abolished in August 2023 due to overall low build quality on most areas and lack of motivation to review them properly.
They were replaced by Hamlets in the same month.

HS2.desc: HS2, or High Speed Two, is the second High Speed operator in CashCraft, serving the suburbs/outer areas of the South, as well as the Airport and the core area of New Arbridge.

GAR.desc: GAR, or Greater Arbridge Railways, is a Heavy Rail operator primarily focused on New Arbridge and its suburbs. It was originally created back in 2022 and has since expanded to Redferry, Harlowfield and Cashvillage.

SVR.desc:
SVR, or South Valley Railways, is a heavy rail operator created by Boowan and Jack, under the supervision of Cash, Dweller and Squad, focused on serving the suburban and outer areas of CashCraft. It currently serves areas such as Welsemere, Milton Hill, Elderville, Hemstead South, Malburn and many other locations located in the far south!
It's currently managed by Boowan and Jack.

Ailsbury Connect.desc: Ailsbury Connect is a heavy rail operator created by Supa101 in june 2023. It's mostly composed of diesel lines that primarily serves the western areas of Ailsbury and its suburbs.

NAT.desc: NAT, or New Arbridge Trams, is one of the 4 light rail operators in CashCraft. It serves the New Arbridge Area and goes all the way to the suburbs on the east, Harlowfield and even Hemstead.

Fernhill Trams.desc: Fernhill Trams is a former tram operator built by Jack and Dweller that primarily focused on serving Fernhill. After Jack's resignation, most of the tram infrastructure was destroyed, with it being eventually redone by AJ_Transport (the same person behind NAT) months later. It currently serves the areas near River Fernhill.

NOT.desc: NOT, or New Oak Trams, was created as a split of NAT and is primarily focused on serving New Oak Common. This operator is entirely managed by Jonathaniplayz, the Hamlet Developer of that area.

Tour Guides.desc: Tour Guides was a former position within the staff team, responsible for hosting tours to the new members who joined the server. Most of them either became inactive, got too many points/demoted or got busy with other tasks and so, this role was abolished sometime during 2022 and eventually got replaced by the Tour Video.

CashBot.desc: CashBot is a bot developed by Arcoda and responsible for interacting with the minecraft server from within the discord server. It's used when the ST isn't available and an emergency restart needs to be done and/or if commands need to be ran without being able to join the server.

ArcodaBot.desc:
ArcodaBot is just there, really.
||and it's also responsible for mc chat logs lol||

CC Assistance.desc:
CC Assistance is a bot coded by Movies22 and responsible for handling plots and plot reminders, minecraft account linking, points, experience, metro status and much more!
It was created back in February 2023 to facilitate the job of manually logging which plots were claimed (and by who) on a google sheets document.

Event Planners.desc:
Event Planners are the newest position within the staff team, being responsible for hosting events and keeping the community engaged.
They were created following a suggestion from the previous Community Feedback Form.

Server Operators.desc: Server Operators are responsible for moderating both in-game and on the discord. They also receive OP permissions in-game, said permissions ranging from /ban and /kick to WorldEdit/specific plugin commads.

CashCraft Management Team.desc:
The CC Management Team, formerly composed by Cash, Arcoda, Dweller and Squad (currently composed by Cash, Movies and Squad) is responsible for important decision making, such as the creation of new positions (i.e. Event Planners) or the creation of new things within the server (i.e. the SMP and Hamlets).
Due to drama within the team in December 2023, a set of Transparency Guidelines were created and followed since, to make sure that communication about server-impacting decisions was done properly in the future.

Transparency Guidelines.desc:
The Transparency Guidelines, proposed by Squad, were created following the waves of shock and arguing within the staff team following the promotion of someone to Transport Staff.
These guidelines specify what kind of decisions need to be communicated to the server before they're put into effect and in what order said decisions should be announced.

You can read the full announcement [here](https://discord.com/channels/903230722603614279/903230723069198378/1186410500725145750).

Server Technician.desc:
The Server Technician is responsible for keeping the server alive, by updating its software, renewing it, fixing any bugs/vulnerabilities and making sure that everything is running smoothly. The Server Technician is also responsible for maintaining the multiple bots and services that are used to interact with the server.
The current Server Technician is Movies22, with Arcoda assisting in the background.

Land Manager.desc:
The Land Manager was responsible for managing the land on the server, by approving/denying village extensions. It was also briefly responsible for managing the Project Areas scheme.
This position was occupied by DwellerUK until july 2023, when he resigned, with the position being abolished and currently being shared by Cash and Squad.

Community Manager.desc:
The Community Manager, formerly Engagement Manager, is responsible for whitelisting people into the server, managing events, interacting with the community through feedback forms, suggestions..., as well as managing the new members scheme and making sure that they receive all information they need.
More recently, it's also responsible for the Event Planners team, making sure that they host events and are active within the community.
Squad is the current Community Manager, replacing Noah who was too inactive for this position. More recently, Squad also received the duties of Land Manager, following Dweller's resignation.

Village Governor.desc:
Village Governors are responsible for managing their village, by building on it, expanding it, keeping it up to standards and releasing plots for the community to claim.
The current village governors are Boowan, Generic, Supa and Squad, with some former village governors being Jack, Dweller and Noah.
This role has the same permissions as the Server Operators role and is merely just OP with more responsibility.

SBoat.desc: SBoat was a boat operator by Supa101 which operated multiple lines of boat services along CashCraft's rivers and seas. A majority of the docks along the line looked like bus stops, and they did't look particularly good. Originally there were concrete trails guiding the users along the line, however, there were complaints about them ruining the scenery. So, attempts were made to replace them with particles, which turned out to not be ideal either as they cause quite a bit of lag. At last, due to lack of motivation to fix the big issues, SBoat was discontinued in 2023.

Hamlet Developers.desc:
Hamlet Developers, formerly Project Area Developers, and more recently, Developers, are responsible for building their Hamlet/LV Zone, as well as releasing plots on it.
Developers are given WorldEdit permissions to be able to work on their area freely.
This role was introduced by Squad to replace the degrading Project Areas scheme.

Purpur.desc: [Purpur](https://purpurmc.org/) is a minecraft server software, based on Paper/CraftBukkit, which is currently being used as CashCraft's server software due to its optimizations.

TrainCarts2.desc: [TrainCarts2](https://github.com/Movs22/TrainCarts2-Cashcraft) is a plugin developed by Movies22 (with some contributions by Jack) which is responsible for controlling all automated metro lines. It replaced TrainCarts 1 in june 2023, due to the growing complexity of the metro network.

Warham.desc:
A small hamlet located on the mountainous area south of Hemstead. It is served by pink, blue and green lines and SVR, with Warham Valley being the biggest station. It is home to the biggest ski centre and some historic monuments.
The developer is FedererTDLB.

Joke.desc: A thing that someone says to cause amusement or laughter, especially a story with a funny punchline.

Absolute Solver.desc:
The Solver of the Absolute Fabric, often shortened to AbsoluteSolver or Solver, is the main antagonist of Murder Drones.

It is an incredibly advanced, supernatural artificial intelligence that mutates in damaged forms of lesser AI, especially Worker Drones constructed by JCJenson. Originally, the Solver manifested in and possessed the improperly disposed Cyn, eventually recovered by Tessa Elliott to reside at Elliott Manor. However, it allowed its hazardous effects to spread among various Workers at the mansion, corrupting their programming to help the Solver massacre an entire gala held there. After exploding the entire planet Earth, the Solver, through Cyn, built Disassembly Drones and deployed them to various exoplanets to perform its bidding unknowingly, including creating spires of dead lifeforms and infiltrating Cabin Fever Labs facilities.

On Copper 9, scientists brought about the Solver's programming into various test subjects Workers, such as Nori Doorman and Yeva, to study it, only for the AI to possess Nori and soon cause the collapse of Copper 9's core, executing all organic life on the planet. Nori and Yeva, still infected by the mutations, had then passed on their corrupted programming into their respective offspring, Uzi Doorman and Doll. While Doll was able to utilize her Solver powers to her advantage, Uzi's affliction grew uncontrollable at times, slowly allowing the AI to fully possess her.

AlCorp.desc:
Founded by i620, Lazer and Federer in early 2023 AlCorp is now the biggest corporation in CashCraft. The current directors are Federer, Lazer, Movies and Generic with many more important members and companies.
Its purpose is to make companies collaborate, help each other and build important and great projects.
New members can join with the application which isn't always open, so don't miss the opportunity!
